# AMZN — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 29 after close) were a blowout — EPS $2.78 vs $1.63 consensus, revenue $181.5B, AWS +28% YoY to $37.6B. The catalyst fired and was immediately "sold": price gapped to $273.88 on April 30, then closed at $265.06 on 2.05x volume. The earnings event is now fully priced. No new binary catalyst exists within the next 10 trading days. Next Q2 earnings estimated ~July 30, 2026. Amazon Ads Upfront (May 11, NYC) is the nearest dated event but is ad-showcase not a binary. [source: web_research/AMZN.json, run 20260501_173921]

---

---

## Q1 2026 earnings synthesis (fired — now priced)

**Beat magnitude:** EPS $2.78 vs $1.63 estimate (+$1.15 beat, 70% upside surprise). Revenue $181.5B. AWS $37.6B (+28% YoY, fastest growth in 15 quarters). Q2 2026 revenue guide ~$188.9B. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

**Market reaction:** "Sell the news" — price gapped to $273.88 on April 30, closed at $265.06. Bearish shooting star on 2.05x average volume. The beat was already embedded in the pre-earnings price run (+27% in the prior month per web_research/AMZN.json).

**Key partnerships announced alongside Q1:** Anthropic committed $100B+ over 10 years to AWS; OpenAI shifted cloud infrastructure from Microsoft Azure to Amazon AWS; Meta signed AWS Graviton5 AI-workload deal worth billions. These are structural bull signals but are absorbed into the current price. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

---

## Competitor activity (post-Q1 context)

AWS retains ~31% cloud share vs Azure ~24% and Google Cloud ~12%. Azure grew +40% (Microsoft Q3 FY2026) and Google Cloud grew +63% in Q1 2026 — both closing the gap from a smaller base. However, OpenAI's cloud departure from Azure to AWS is a direct market-share catalyst. Hyperscalers plan $725B combined capex in 2026 (+77% YoY); Amazon is guiding ~$200B. The AI capex race benefits AWS disproportionately given new Anthropic, OpenAI, and Meta anchor deals. [source: web_research/AMZN.json]

---

## What would reactivate the long catalyst stack

- **Price pulls back to $252–$258:** Trend-momentum and macro-context agents would re-engage with a 2:1+ R:R long entry.
- **Acceptance above $270.62 on volume:** Catalyst-news agent would re-evaluate bullish re-entry above hourly resistance.
- **AWS Q2 guidance beat:** Material upside to the $188.9B Q2 guide would re-rate the stock higher and override current mean-reversion bias.
